ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA - Must be an Indian citizen and resident of any State or Union Territory in India. - The applicant household must own a residential house with a suitable roof space that is structurally sound and unshaded for solar panel installation. - The household must have a valid domestic (residential) grid electricity connection in their name from the local DISCOM (Electricity Distribution Company, e.g., GESCOM, BESCOM, BSES, Tata Power, Mahavitaran, UPPCL, WBSEDCL). - The household must not have availed any previous solar rooftop subsidy from central or state government for the same premises. 4. REQUIRED DOCUMENTS - Aadhaar Card of the electricity consumer/applicant. - Latest domestic electricity bill (showing Consumer Account Number / CA Number / Account ID). - Bank account passbook or cancelled cheque (Aadhaar linked for DBT transfer). - Electricity Connection proof / Property ownership proof / Land certificate. - Mobile number linked with Aadhaar. 5. APPLICATION PROCEDURE Step 1: Register on the National Portal at https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in by selecting your State, Electricity Distribution Utility (DISCOM), and entering your Consumer Account Number. Step 2: Submit the application for Rooftop Solar with your electricity bill details. Step 3: Receive technical feasibility approval from your local DISCOM. Step 4: Install the rooftop solar plant through any registered/empanelled solar vendor

text: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN) 1. Scope and Scheme Benefits: PM-KISAN is a central sector scheme to supplement financial requirements of landholding farmers for procuring various inputs related to agriculture and allied activities as well as domestic needs. - Annual Income Support: Rs. 6,000 per family per year. - Mode of Payment: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the verified Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of beneficiaries in three equal quarterly installments of Rs. 2,000 each (April-July, August-November, December-March). 2. Beneficiary Definition and Eligibility: - Eligible Beneficiary: All landholding farmers' families having cultivable landholding in their names are eligible. - A landholding farmer's family is defined as consisting of husband, wife, and minor children who own cultivable land as per land records of the concerned State/UT. 3. Exclusions and Ineligibility: - Institutional landholders. - Farmer families wherein one or more members belong to the following categories: a) Former and present holders of constitutional posts. b) Former and present Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors, Chairpersons of District Panchayats. c) Serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries, Departments, and PSUs. d) All superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs. 10,000 or more. e) All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year. f) Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with professional bodies. 4. Essential Documents & Requirements: - Land ownership records: Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops (RTC / Pahani in Karnataka Bhoomi portal). - Aadhaar Card (mandatory e-KYC via OTP or biometric authentication). - Bank Account linked to Aadhaar (NPCI mapped). - Active mobile number registered with Aadhaar. 5. Application Procedure in Karnataka & Vijayanagara District: - Portal: https://pmkisan.gov.in (Farmers Corner > New Farmer Registration). - Karnataka Bhoomi Portal link verifies land records automatically via FID (Farmer Identification number / FRUITS database). - Help centers: Raitha Samparka Kendras (RSK) located in Hosapete, Harapanahalli, Kudligi, Huvina Hadagali, Hagaribommanahalli, and Kottur.

text: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA & GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA National Health Authority & Suvarna Arogya Suraksha Trust (SAST) POLICY MANUAL: AYUSHMAN BHARAT - PRADHAN MANTRI JAN AROGYA YOJANA (AB-PMJAY) - AROGYA KARNATAKA 1. Scheme Overview: Ayushman Bharat - Arogya Karnataka (AB-ArK) is a co-branded universal health assurance scheme providing comprehensive cashless treatment coverage to citizens of Karnataka for secondary and tertiary healthcare conditions. 2. Financial Coverage: - Eligible Category (BPL / AAY / SECC Beneficiaries): Up to Rs. 5,00,000 (Five Lakhs) per family per year on a family floater basis for specified surgical and medical treatments across empaneled public and private hospitals. - General Category (APL Families): 30% co-payment coverage by government up to Rs. 1,50,000 per family per year. 3. Eligibility: - Residents of Karnataka possessing a valid Ration Card (BPL or APL) or listed in the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) database. - Must hold an Ayushman Bharat Health Card (ABHA / Ayushman Card). 4. Access to Healthcare & Referral Procedure: - Primary Care & Emergency: Patients can directly access government health facilities (PHC, CHC, Taluk Hospital Hosapete, Harapanahalli, Kudligi). - Secondary & Tertiary Care: Patient must visit the nearest Taluk General Hospital or District Hospital. If treatment is not available, an official online referral (SAST Referral Code) is generated to empaneled private hospitals. - Emergency Cases: Direct admission without prior referral is permitted in empaneled hospitals for life-threatening medical emergencies. 5. Key Documents: - Aadhaar Card of each family member. - BPL / Antyodaya Ration Card issued by Food & Civil Supplies Department. - Ayushman Card (can be generated at CSC / Grama One / Arogya Mitra counter). 6. Service Network in Vijayanagara District: - District Hospital Hosapete, Taluk Hospital Harapanahalli, Kudligi Taluk Hospital, Community Health Centre Hadagali, Hagaribommanahalli, Kottur. - Arogya Mitra Help Desks are stationed 24/7 at all government general hospitals to guide citizens. - Official Portals: https://pmjay.gov.in and https://sast.karnataka.gov.in

text: GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA Department of Women and Child Development OFFICIAL SCHEME GUIDELINES: GRUHA LAKSHMI YOJANA 1. Objective: The Gruha Lakshmi scheme is a flagship social welfare initiative of the Government of Karnataka that provides financial assistance of Rs. 2,000 per month directly to the bank account of the eligible female head of the family (Gruha Lakshmi) to empower women and support household expenditures. 2. Eligibility Criteria: - Domicile: The applicant woman must be a permanent resident of Karnataka. - Family Position: The woman must be designated as the head of the family in the Antyodaya (AAY), Below Poverty Line (BPL), or Above Poverty Line (APL) ration cards. - Single Beneficiary: Only one woman in a family is eligible for the assistance. - Disqualification: If the woman or her husband is an Income Tax payer or files Goods and Services Tax (GST) returns, she is not eligible for the financial benefit. - Government Employees: Women who are employed in government service or pensioners are ineligible. 3. Required Documents: - Aadhaar Card of the applicant (must be linked to bank account). - Aadhaar Card of the husband (for verification of non-taxpayer status). - Ration Card number (BPL, Antyodaya, or APL card issued by Food and Civil Supplies Dept, Karnataka). - Bank Passbook with active IFSC code and bank account seeded with Aadhaar for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). - Active mobile number linked with Aadhaar. 4. Application Process: - Online Application: Citizens can register through the Seva Sindhu Portal (https://sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in) free of charge. - Assisted Service Delivery: In Vijayanagara District and across Karnataka, applications can be submitted at Grama One, Karnataka One, Bangalore One, or Bapuji Seva Kendra. - SMS Slot Scheduling: Beneficiaries receive an SMS with the date, time, and service centre assigned for document verification. - Approval Authority: Department of Women and Child Development, District Office Vijayanagara at Hosapete. - Official Portal: https://sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in

text: GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood Department GOVERNMENT ORDER: YUVA NIDHI SCHEME 1. Purpose and Benefit Amount: The Yuva Nidhi scheme provides monthly financial assistance and career empowerment for educated youth of Karnataka who have completed graduation or diploma courses and remain unemployed after completing their degree. - Degree / Post-Graduate Holders: Rs. 3,000 per month. - Diploma Holders: Rs. 1,500 per month. - Tenure: Benefits are provided for a maximum period of two years (24 months) or until the youth secures employment/self-employment, whichever is earlier. 2. Eligibility Criteria: - Domicile: The candidate must have studied in Karnataka for at least 6 years or possess a valid Karnataka domicile. - Qualification: Must have passed Bachelor's Degree, Post-Graduation, or Polytechnic Diploma from an institution recognized by UGC/AICTE/State Board of Technical Education. - Unemployment Window: Must remain unemployed for a minimum of 180 days (6 months) after the declaration of final examination results. - Employment Restriction: Candidates who are enrolled in higher full-time studies, government or private employment, or are drawing apprenticeship stipends are not eligible. - Tax Payer Exclusion: Beneficiaries must not be income tax payees. 3. Mandatory Documents: - Marksheets of SSLC, PUC/12th, and Degree/Diploma certificate. - University Convocation Certificate or Provisional Degree Certificate (PDC). - Aadhaar Card with bank seeding for DBT. - Domicile / Study Certificate proving minimum 6 years education in Karnataka. - Self-declaration of unemployment status on Seva Sindhu. 4. Application Channel: - Applications are submitted online via Seva Sindhu portal (https://sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in) or at nearest Grama One kendras in taluks of Hosapete, Harapanahalli, Kudligi, Huvina Hadagali, Hagaribommanahalli, and Kottur. - Beneficiaries must update monthly self-declaration of unemployment between the 25th and last day of every month to receive subsequent installments.

text: GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA Center for e-Governance & Social Welfare Department GUIDELINES: STATE SCHOLARSHIP PORTAL (SSP) POST-MATRIC & VIDYASIRI SCHOLARSHIPS 1. Objective: The State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Karnataka is a unified electronic application platform for all post-matric scholarship schemes provided by the Social Welfare, Backward Classes Welfare, Tribal Welfare, Minorities Welfare, and Technical Education departments. 2. Schemes Integrated on SSP: - Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students (Full Fee Waiver & Maintenance). - Vidyasiri (Food and Accommodation Scheme / Oota & Vasathi Nilaya Sahayadhana): Rs. 1,500 per month for students not admitted to government hostels. - Fee Concession Scheme for Backward Classes (Cat-1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B). - Chief Minister's Higher Education Scholarship. 3. Eligibility Norms: - Student must be a permanent resident of Karnataka. - Must have completed SSLC / 10th standard and be enrolled in recognized PUC, ITI, Diploma, Undergraduate, or Postgraduate courses in Karnataka. - Income Limits: * SC / ST Students: Annual family income up to Rs. 2,50,000 for full fee reimbursement. * Backward Classes (Cat-1): Annual family income up to Rs. 2,50,000. * Backward Classes (Cat-2A, 2B, 3A, 3B): Annual family income up to Rs. 1,00,000. - Minimum Attendance: At least 75% attendance in the enrolled educational institution. 4. Required Documents: - Student Aadhaar Number and Aadhaar Consent Form. - SATS (Student Achievement Tracking System) ID or College Registration Number. - Caste and Income Certificate RD Number (issued by Revenue Dept via Nadakacheri). - E-Authentication of Fee Receipt from the college. - Bank Account linked with Aadhaar (NPCI active status). 5. Application Portal: - Official URL: https://ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in - Common application window opens annually between August and November. - District Social Welfare Officer, Vijayanagara District: Mini Vidhana Soudha, Hosapete.

text: # PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (Central Government Scheme) # Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Government of India # Official Portal: https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in | Launch Year: 2024 | Jurisdiction: All India (Central Government) 1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE AND OVERVIEW PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana is a flagship national initiative by the Central Government aimed at providing free electricity up to 300 units per month to 1 crore (10 million) households across all States and Union Territories in India by installing rooftop solar systems. 2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA - Must be an Indian citizen and resident of any State or Union Territory in India. - The applicant household must own a residential house with a suitable roof space that is structurally sound and unshaded for solar panel installation. - The household must have a valid domestic (residential) grid electricity connection in their name from the local DISCOM (Electricity Distribution Company, e.g., GESCOM, BESCOM, BSES, Tata Power, Mahavitaran, UPPCL, WBSEDCL). - The household must not have availed any previous solar rooftop subsidy from central or state government for the same premises. 4. REQUIRED DOCUMENTS - Aadhaar Card of the electricity consumer/applicant. - Latest domestic electricity bill (showing Consumer Account Number / CA Number / Account ID). - Bank account passbook or cancelled cheque (Aadhaar linked for DBT transfer). - Electricity Connection proof / Property ownership proof / Land certificate. - Mobile number linked with Aadhaar. 5. APPLICATION PROCEDURE Step 1: Register on the National Portal at https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in by selecting your State, Electricity Distribution Utility (DISCOM), and entering your Consumer Account Number. Step 2: Submit the application for Rooftop Solar with your electricity bill details. Step 3: Receive technical feasibility approval from your local DISCOM. Step 4: Install the rooftop solar plant through any registered/empanelled solar vendor

text: # Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) (Central Government Scheme) # Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India # Official Portal: https://www.mudra.org.in & https://udyamimitra.in | Jurisdiction: All India (Central Government) 1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE AND OVERVIEW Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) is a flagship Central Government initiative launched to provide collateral-free institutional micro-credit to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises across India. The scheme promotes self-employment, entrepreneurship, and financial inclusion. 2. LOAN CATEGORIES AND CEILINGS MUDRA loans are divided into three distinct categories reflecting the stage of growth and funding needs of the micro-unit or entrepreneur: 1. Shishu (Seed / Start-up stage): - Covers loans up to Rs. 50,000. - Designed for micro entrepreneurs starting a new small business or hawkers, shopkeepers, fruit/vegetable vendors. - Zero processing fee and no margin money requirement. 2. Kishor (Growing Business stage): - Covers loans above Rs. 50,000 and up to Rs. 5,00,000. - Designed for business owners looking to purchase machinery, inventory, equipment, or working capital. - Margin requirement usually up to 15%. 3. Tarun (Expansion stage) & Tarun Plus: - Tarun covers loans above Rs. 5,00,000 and up to Rs. 10,00,000. - Tarun Plus covers loans up to Rs. 20,00,000 for entrepreneurs who have previously availed and successfully repaid Tarun loans. - Suitable for established small manufacturing units, processing facilities, transport vehicles, service companies. 3. KEY FEATURES AND ADVANTAGES - No Collateral Security: Loans under PMMY are 100% collateral-free. No mortgage or third-party guarantee is required. - Credit Guarantee: Supported by the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU) managed by NCGTC. - MUDRA Card: Borrowers receive a RuPay debit card associated with their cash credit/overdraft account for convenient ATM withdrawals and digital POS transactions. - Flexible Repayment: Repayment periods typically range from 3 to 5 years (up to 7 years in specific capital cases) with moratorium periods based on cash flows. - Nominal Interest Rates: Interest rates are linked to bank Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR) / Repo-linked benchmarks, making borrowing affordable. 4. text: # Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) (Central Government Scheme) # Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India # Official Portal: https://www.mudra.org.in & https://udyamimitra.in | Jurisdiction: All India (Central Government) 1. text: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN) 1. Scope and Scheme Benefits: PM-KISAN is a central sector scheme to supplement financial requirements of landholding farmers for procuring various inputs related to agriculture and allied activities as well as domestic needs. - Annual Income Support: Rs. 6,000 per family per year. - Mode of Payment: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the verified Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of beneficiaries in three equal quarterly installments of Rs. 2,000 each (April-July, August-November, December-March). 2. Beneficiary Definition and Eligibility: - Eligible Beneficiary: All landholding farmers' families having cultivable landholding in their names are eligible. - A landholding farmer's family is defined as consisting of husband, wife, and minor children who own cultivable land as per land records of the concerned State/UT. 3. Exclusions and Ineligibility: - Institutional landholders. - Farmer families wherein one or more members belong to the following categories: a) Former and present holders of constitutional posts. b) Former and present Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors, Chairpersons of District Panchayats. c) Serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries, Departments, and PSUs. d) All superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs. 10,000 or more. e) All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year. f) Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with professional bodies. 4. Essential Documents & Requirements: - Land ownership records: Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops (RTC / Pahani in Karnataka Bhoomi portal). - Aadhaar Card (mandatory e-KYC via OTP or biometric authentication). - Bank Account linked to Aadhaar (NPCI mapped). - Active mobile number registered with Aadhaar. 5. Application Procedure in Karnataka & Vijayanagara District: - Portal: https://pmkisan.gov.in (Farmers Corner > New Farmer Registration). - Karnataka Bhoomi Portal link verifies land records automatically via FID (Farmer Identification number / FRUITS database). - Help centers: Raitha Samparka Kendras (RSK) located in Hosapete, Harapanahalli, Kudligi, Huvina Hadagali, Hagaribommanahalli, and Kottur.

Purpose and Benefit Amount: The Yuva Nidhi scheme provides monthly financial assistance and career empowerment for educated youth of Karnataka who have completed graduation or diploma courses and remain unemployed after completing their degree. - Degree / Post-Graduate Holders: Rs. 3,000 per month. - Diploma Holders: Rs. 1,500 per month. - Tenure: Benefits are provided for a maximum period of two years (24 months) or until the youth secures employment/self-employment, whichever is earlier. 2. Eligibility Criteria: - Domicile: The candidate must have studied in Karnataka for at least 6 years or possess a valid Karnataka domicile. - Qualification: Must have passed Bachelor's Degree, Post-Graduation, or Polytechnic Diploma from an institution recognized by UGC/AICTE/State Board of Technical Education. - Unemployment Window: Must remain unemployed for a minimum of 180 days (6 months) after the declaration of final examination results. - Employment Restriction: Candidates who are enrolled in higher full-time studies, government or private employment, or are drawing apprenticeship stipends are not eligible. - Tax Payer Exclusion: Beneficiaries must not be income tax payees. 3. Mandatory Documents: - Marksheets of SSLC, PUC/12th, and Degree/Diploma certificate. - University Convocation Certificate or Provisional Degree Certificate (PDC). - Aadhaar Card with bank seeding for DBT. - Domicile / Study Certificate proving minimum 6 years education in Karnataka. - Self-declaration of unemployment status on Seva Sindhu. 4. Application Channel: - Applications are submitted online via Seva Sindhu portal (https://sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in) or at nearest Grama One kendras in taluks of Hosapete, Harapanahalli, Kudligi, Huvina Hadagali, Hagaribommanahalli, and Kottur. - Beneficiaries must update monthly self-declaration of unemployment between the 25th and last day of every month to receive subsequent installments.

text: GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA Center for e-Governance & Social Welfare Department GUIDELINES: STATE SCHOLARSHIP PORTAL (SSP) POST-MATRIC & VIDYASIRI SCHOLARSHIPS 1. Objective: The State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Karnataka is a unified electronic application platform for all post-matric scholarship schemes provided by the Social Welfare, Backward Classes Welfare, Tribal Welfare, Minorities Welfare, and Technical Education departments. 2. Schemes Integrated on SSP: - Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students (Full Fee Waiver & Maintenance). - Vidyasiri (Food and Accommodation Scheme / Oota & Vasathi Nilaya Sahayadhana): Rs. 1,500 per month for students not admitted to government hostels. - Fee Concession Scheme for Backward Classes (Cat-1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B). - Chief Minister's Higher Education Scholarship. 3. Eligibility Norms: - Student must be a permanent resident of Karnataka. - Must have completed SSLC / 10th standard and be enrolled in recognized PUC, ITI, Diploma, Undergraduate, or Postgraduate courses in Karnataka. - Income Limits: * SC / ST Students: Annual family income up to Rs. 2,50,000 for full fee reimbursement. * Backward Classes (Cat-1): Annual family income up to Rs. 2,50,000. * Backward Classes (Cat-2A, 2B, 3A, 3B): Annual family income up to Rs. 1,00,000. - Minimum Attendance: At least 75% attendance in the enrolled educational institution. 4. Required Documents: - Student Aadhaar Number and Aadhaar Consent Form. - SATS (Student Achievement Tracking System) ID or College Registration Number. - Caste and Income Certificate RD Number (issued by Revenue Dept via Nadakacheri). - E-Authentication of Fee Receipt from the college. - Bank Account linked with Aadhaar (NPCI active status). 5. Application Portal: - Official URL: https://ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in - Common application window opens annually between August and November. - District Social Welfare Officer, Vijayanagara District: Mini Vidhana Soudha, Hosapete.
